_about: Which offer the rules prescribe for a prospect, and why. Read by tools/call_engine/prep.py. Prices are NOT kept here on purpose: they change, and the live numbers are on the Notion pages under 'sources'. Every prep run re-reads those pages; if they disagree with this file, the pages win and the prep page says so. Rules are checked top to bottom; the first match wins.

route_out.label: Route out, not a fit today
on_call: Act on the qualifying answer. Do not rebuild them into a fit.

travel_nurse.label: Travel Nurse Referral Starter Pack
travel_nurse.guarantee: none written yet; check the Packages page
travel_nurse.why_template: Rooms rent to travel nurses, not senior residents.

referral_starter.label: Senior Care Referral Starter Pack
referral_starter.guarantee: none written yet; check the Packages page
referral_starter.why_template: Cannot fund daily ad spend, so start with case managers and discharge planners.
on_call: Ask first: is that ad budget something you can do?
Only if the answer is no, offer this.

full_bed_system.label: 90 Day Full Bed System (ads, done for you)
full_bed_system.guarantee: Tours: the 'Dollar Menu' guarantee. [x] qualified tours in 90 days, or we work free and pay the ad spend until we hit it.
full_bed_system.why_template: Default ads offer. The guarantee is in tours.
on_call: Tier is prescribed, not chosen. Option close on payment terms only.
Sell the process, not the guarantee.

full_bed_system_resident_headline.label: 90 Day Full Bed System, with the resident headline allowed
full_bed_system_resident_headline.guarantee: The resident (move-in) number may be used as the headline. Advise them down to the tours guarantee; it is what gets delivered.
full_bed_system_resident_headline.why_template: 8 or more empty beds and the staff to take them.
on_call: Capacity screen out loud first: could you staff 5 more tours next month?
Expect to advise down to tours.

downsells: Call support to text support (ask, don't assert)
deposit: Refundable deposit link is in the Close-Call Kit. Use it when 2 or more logistical objections stack. Never invent an amount on the call.

verify_on_call.empty_beds: How many beds, how many empty today?
verify_on_call.staffing_ok: If 5 more families toured next month, could you staff them?
verify_on_call.can_fund_ads: The plan needs a daily ad budget paid to Meta. Is that something you can do?
verify_on_call.uses_placement_agents: Do you use placement agents? What do they charge per move-in?
verify_on_call.rent: What is a month's rent per bed?
verify_on_call.community_type: Licensed as what: assisted living, memory care, board and care?
